official_data_source.source_name: Lean 4 computational complexity and algorithmic proof corpus
official_data_source.source_authority: Lean project and Logion formal proof corpus steward

target_variable.name: complexity_algorithmic_heldout_proof_obligations
target_variable.extraction_rule: Hold back expected_bound_or_correctness_verdict, proof_or_counterexample_ref, aggregate bound-class pass/fail counts until the formal proof route materializes from validation/heldout/grand_science/formal_mathematics/coverage_work_orders/planned_corpora/computational_complexity_algorithmic_proof/OC133_COMPLEXITY_ALGORITHMIC_FORMAL_INPUTS.json.
target_variable.target_statement: For held-out algorithm specifications, loop invariants, recurrences, and input-size measures, prove the declared correctness and asymptotic upper-bound verdict or provide an executable counterexample.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Materialize a Lean/finite proof of algorithmic correctness or complexity-bound preservation, or a checked counterexample. Empirical runtime measurements may only appear as negative controls.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: infer the visible majority bound class or correctness verdict from sample executions only, without a machine-checkable invariant, recurrence, or proof certificate
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model_mismatch_count == 0, comparator_mismatch_count > 0, and invariant/recurrence mutation controls are rejected

uncertainty_requirement.rule: No empirical uncertainty interval is applicable; asymptotic claims require proof/counterexample replay.

residual_requirement.formula: sum(1 if preregistered_formal_verdict != executed_formal_verdict else 0) over locked formal rows
residual_requirement.definition: 0/1 mismatch between the preregistered formal proof verdict and the executed proof or counterexample verdict; aggregate count and exact zero required for formal support.
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_mismatch_count == 0, comparator_mismatch_count > 0, and invariant/recurrence mutation controls are rejected

negative_control_requirement.rule: mutated proof obligations fail while the locked formal obligations replay exactly
negative_control_requirement.description: Mutate a loop invariant, recurrence base case, or monotonicity premise after source lock; the formal replay must reject the corrupted proof route.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: runtime timing, benchmark speed, or empirical scaling fit is used as proof of complexity; withheld bound verdicts or counterexample refs leak before proof materialization; fewer than 20 formal-equivalent algorithmic proof obligations replay; sample-run/majority comparator ties or beats the formal derivation; any invariant, recurrence, proof certificate, or counterexample ref is missing or unhashable
trigger_predicates: runtime timing, benchmark speed, or empirical scaling fit is used as proof of complexity
withheld bound verdicts or counterexample refs leak before proof materialization
fewer than 20 formal-equivalent algorithmic proof obligations replay
sample-run/majority comparator ties or beats the formal derivation
any invariant, recurrence, proof certificate, or counterexample ref is missing or unhashable

current_evidence.reason: Deterministic formal-route complexity inputs, executed proof corpus, withheld aggregate lock, and scorer are materialized and replay cleanly. Coverage remains open pending formal coverage-scope review.
